Package fr.univpoitiers.core.rules

Interface RuleApplier

All Known Implementing Classes:
Solver
public interface RuleApplier
Utility interface providing static methods to apply heuristic deduction rules on a Sudoku grid (Pointing Pairs/Triples, Box-Line Reductions, X-Wing, Y-Wing, Swordfish).
